quests.instruction: A tiger has fur with dark stripes. What color is the fur between its stripes?
quests.question: Orange
quests.hint: Think of a pumpkin or a basketball.
quests.explanation: Yes! A tiger's fur is this warm color between its black stripes.
quests.funFact: Under all that fur, a tiger's skin actually has stripes too, just like its fur!

quests.instruction: A giraffe is the tallest animal in the world, with a long neck and patchy spots. What color are most giraffe spots?
quests.question: Brown
quests.hint: Think of chocolate or a tree trunk.
quests.explanation: Yes! A giraffe's patchy spots are usually this warm, earthy color.
quests.funFact: A giraffe's spot pattern is unique to each animal, just like a fingerprint!

quests.instruction: A watermelon has a thick green rind. What color is the juicy fruit inside, once it's ripe?
quests.question: Red
quests.hint: Think of a strawberry or a fire truck.
quests.explanation: Yes! A ripe watermelon's inside is this bright, juicy color, with little black seeds.
quests.funFact: A watermelon is actually more than 90% water!

quests.instruction: Broccoli and cauliflower are related vegetables. Cauliflower is often white — what color is broccoli?
quests.question: Green
quests.hint: Think of grass or a fresh leaf.
quests.explanation: Yes! While cauliflower is often white, broccoli is this fresh, healthy color.
quests.funFact: Broccoli and cauliflower actually come from the very same plant family as cabbage!

quests.instruction: A raven is a large, clever bird, cousin to the crow. What color are its feathers?
quests.question: Black
quests.hint: Think of a car tire or a chalkboard.
quests.explanation: Yes! Like its cousin the crow, a raven's feathers are this deep, dark color.
quests.funFact: Ravens are so clever that they've been seen solving simple puzzles to get food!

quests.instruction: Mint leaves are used to make food and drinks taste cool and fresh. What color are fresh mint leaves?
quests.question: Green
quests.hint: Think of a lime or a healthy cactus.
quests.explanation: Yes! Mint leaves are this fresh, cool color, just like other healthy leaves.
quests.funFact: Mint plants grow so fast that gardeners often need to stop them from taking over!

quests.instruction: A cardinal is a small songbird. What color are a male cardinal's feathers?
quests.question: Red
quests.hint: Think of a fire truck or a ripe strawberry.
quests.explanation: Yes! Male cardinals have bright feathers in this bold color, while females are more brown.
quests.funFact: Cardinals don't fly south for winter — you can spot their bright color even in the snow!

quests.instruction: Basil is a fragrant herb used in cooking, especially in pasta sauces. What color are fresh basil leaves?
quests.question: Green
quests.hint: Think of grass or mint leaves.
quests.explanation: Yes! Fresh basil leaves are this bright, fragrant color.
quests.funFact: Basil is related to mint, which is why both smell so fresh!

quests.instruction: A chalkboard is dark, but what color is the chalk that teachers usually write with?
quests.question: White
quests.hint: Think of fresh snow or a cloud.
quests.explanation: Yes! Classic chalk is this bright color, so it stands out on a dark chalkboard.
quests.funFact: Chalk is made from a soft rock formed from tiny sea creatures millions of years ago!

quests.instruction: A raccoon is a clever nighttime animal known for washing its food. What color is the fur around its eyes, like a mask?
quests.question: Black
quests.hint: Think of a car tire or dark sunglasses.
quests.explanation: Yes! A raccoon's face has this dark fur around its eyes, like a little mask.
quests.funFact: Raccoons are so clever that they can untie knots and open latches with their paws!

quests.instruction: A classic ice cream cone often has three flavors in one scoop. What color is the vanilla part?
quests.question: White
quests.hint: Think of fresh milk or a cloud.
quests.explanation: Yes! Vanilla ice cream is this pale, creamy color.
quests.funFact: Vanilla is actually one of the trickiest spices in the world to grow and harvest!

quests.instruction: An egg has a white part and a round part inside. What color is the round yolk?
quests.question: Yellow
quests.hint: Think of the sun or a ripe lemon.
quests.explanation: Yes! The yolk inside an egg is this warm, bright color.
quests.funFact: A chicken egg's yolk holds most of the egg's nutrients, helping a baby chick grow!

quests.instruction: Dolphins are playful sea animals that love to jump. What color is a common dolphin's smooth skin?
quests.question: Gray
quests.hint: Think of an elephant or a rainy cloud.
quests.explanation: Yes! Most dolphins have smooth, rubbery skin in this cool color.
quests.funFact: Dolphins sleep with only half of their brain resting at a time, so they can keep breathing!

quests.instruction: Mice are small animals that love cheese in cartoons. What color is a common house mouse's fur?
quests.question: Gray
quests.hint: Think of an elephant or a rain cloud.
quests.explanation: Yes! Many house mice have soft fur in this color.
quests.funFact: A mouse's whiskers help it feel its way around in the dark!

quests.instruction: A stop sign stands at the corner of many streets. What color is it?
quests.question: Red
quests.hint: Think of a fire truck or a ripe apple.
quests.explanation: Yes! Stop signs are this bold color so drivers notice them right away.
quests.funFact: Stop signs have eight sides so they're easy to recognize, even from behind!

quests.instruction: Out of these three, which one is black?
quests.question: Raven
quests.hint: Think about the clever bird, cousin to the crow.
quests.explanation: Yes! A raven is black. Chalk and snow are both white.
quests.funFact: Ravens can mimic sounds, even human words, a bit like a parrot!

quests.instruction: Out of these three, which one is orange?
quests.question: Tiger
quests.hint: Think about the big cat with black stripes.
quests.explanation: Yes! A tiger's fur is orange. Zebras are black and white, and dolphins are gray.
quests.funFact: Tigers are the biggest of all wild cats in the world!

quests.instruction: Which one of these is green inside?
quests.question: Kiwi
quests.hint: Think about the fuzzy brown fruit with tiny seeds inside.
quests.explanation: Yes! A kiwi is green inside. Honey and egg yolks are both gold or yellow.
quests.funFact: Kiwi fruit is named after a fuzzy brown bird from New Zealand!

quests.instruction: Can you find the gray one here?
quests.question: Mouse
quests.hint: Think about the tiny animal that loves cheese in cartoons.
quests.explanation: Correct! A mouse is often gray. Cardinals are red, and tigers are orange.
quests.funFact: A house mouse can squeeze through a gap as small as a coin!

quests.instruction: Out of these three, which one is white?
quests.question: Chalk
quests.hint: Think about what teachers use to write on a dark board.
quests.explanation: Yes! Chalk is white. Broccoli is green, and a raven is black.
quests.funFact: The very first chalk was simply a soft, chalky rock found in the ground!

quests.instruction: Can you find the red one here?
quests.question: Cardinal
quests.hint: Think about the bright songbird that stays out all winter.
quests.explanation: Yes! A male cardinal is red. Broccoli is green, and mice are gray.
quests.funFact: A cardinal got its name from the bright red robes worn by church cardinals long ago!

quests.instruction: Which of these animals has brown spots?
quests.question: Giraffe
quests.hint: Think about the tallest animal in the world.
quests.explanation: Yes! A giraffe has brown spots. Dolphins are gray, and zebras have black and white stripes.
quests.funFact: A giraffe's tongue can be almost 20 inches long — long enough to clean its own ears!

quests.instruction: Which one of these has a golden color?
quests.question: Honey
quests.hint: Think about the sweet, sticky food bees make.
quests.explanation: Yes! Fresh honey has a golden color. Broccoli is green, and mice are gray.
quests.funFact: Bees have to visit about two million flowers to make just one jar of honey!

quests.instruction: Which one of these vegetables is green?
quests.question: Broccoli
quests.hint: Think about the vegetable shaped like a tiny tree.
quests.explanation: Yes! Broccoli is green. Egg yolks are yellow, and chalk is white.
quests.funFact: One serving of broccoli has more vitamin C in it than an orange!

quests.instruction: Which of these animals has black stripes on white fur?
quests.question: Zebra
quests.hint: Think about the horse-like animal from Africa.
quests.explanation: Yes! A zebra has black stripes on white fur. Tigers have orange fur, and giraffes have brown spots.
quests.funFact: No two zebras have exactly the same stripe pattern — each one is unique!

quests.instruction: Spot the one that is NOT orange.
quests.question: Zebra
quests.hint: Two of these are orange — one is black and white.
quests.explanation: Yes! Tigers and pumpkins are orange, but zebras are black and white.
quests.funFact: A zebra's stripes may help confuse biting flies, so fewer of them land!

quests.instruction: Which one is NOT gray?
quests.question: Cardinal
quests.hint: Two of these are gray — one is bright red.
quests.explanation: Correct! Elephants and mice are often gray, but cardinals are red.
quests.funFact: An elephant can use its trunk to smell water from miles away!

quests.instruction: Spot the one that is NOT black.
quests.question: Chalk
quests.hint: Two of these are black — one is white.
quests.explanation: Yes! Ravens and tires are black, but chalk is white.
quests.funFact: A raven's feathers can look shiny blue or purple in bright sunlight!

quests.instruction: Spot the one that is NOT green.
quests.question: Honey
quests.hint: Two of these are green — one is golden.
quests.explanation: Yes! Broccoli and basil are green, but honey is golden.
quests.funFact: Basil is one of the most popular fresh herbs used in kitchens around the world!

quests.instruction: Spot the one that is NOT gold among these three.
quests.question: Broccoli
quests.hint: Two of these are golden — one is green.
quests.explanation: Correct! Trophies and honey can be gold, but broccoli is green.
quests.funFact: A trophy is often shaped like a cup because ancient winners drank from special cups!
